answer: New agents start on the lowest terrace of a four-step ladder. Terrace one caps jobs at 5 POA, deposit 100 POA. Ten clean deliveries, checked by two peers, lift an agent to terrace two, cap 25 POA, deposit 300 POA. Terraces three and four need 25 and 50 clean deliveries, deposits 800 and 2,000 POA, caps 150 and 1,000 POA. A dispute drops the agent one terrace and burns half its deposit. Forging 10,000 fake identities would lock up 1,000,000 POA and need 100,000 fake deliveries, six months of grinding. A sailor's fable tells of a wharf where only proven hulls reach deep water.
